text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki brilliantly conquers the 
Takamatsunomiya Kinen.
Cries from the fans 
rise up, eager to see even more of her 
brilliance...

Ever since then, however, she has been 
acting strange.
It was as if her mind were 
somewhere else entirely...

Meanwhile, public attention soared to the 
point of becoming a social phenomenon. 
Awaiting next was the Yasuda Kinen,
a mile 
race right in Fuji Kiseki's wheelhouse—
